name: Stock Turnover
report_script:
columns = [
    {
        "fieldname": "item_group",
        "label": _("Item Group"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Item Group",
        "width": 160
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "item_code",
        "label": _("Item Code"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Item",
        "width": 140
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "item_name",
        "label": _("Item Name"),
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "width": 220
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "stock_uom",
        "label": _("UOM"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "UOM",
        "width": 90
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "warehouse",
        "label": _("Warehouse"),
        "fieldtype": "Link",
        "options": "Warehouse",
        "width": 180
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "opening_qty",
        "label": _("Opening Qty"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 110
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "received_qty",
        "label": _("Received Qty"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 110
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "issued_qty",
        "label": _("Issued Qty"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 110
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "closing_qty",
        "label": _("Closing Qty"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 110
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "opening_value",
        "label": _("Opening Value"),
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 130
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "received_value",
        "label": _("Received Value"),
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 130
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "issued_value",
        "label": _("Issued / COGS Value"),
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 150
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "closing_value",
        "label": _("Closing Value"),
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 130
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "average_inventory_value",
        "label": _("Average Inventory Value"),
        "fieldtype": "Currency",
        "width": 160
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "turnover_ratio",
        "label": _("Turnover Ratio"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 120
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "turnover_days",
        "label": _("Turnover Days"),
        "fieldtype": "Float",
        "width": 120
    },
    {
        "fieldname": "turnover_status",
        "label": _("Turnover Status"),
        "fieldtype": "Data",
        "width": 140
    }
]


filters = filters or {}


query = """
    SELECT

        i.item_group AS item_group,

        sle.item_code AS item_code,

        i.item_name AS item_name,

        i.stock_uom AS stock_uom,

        sle.warehouse AS warehouse,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           OPENING QTY
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sle.posting_date < %(from_date)s
                THEN sle.actual_qty
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS opening_qty,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           RECEIVED QTY
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sle.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
                AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
                AND sle.actual_qty > 0
                THEN sle.actual_qty
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS received_qty,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           ISSUED QTY
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sle.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
                AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
                AND sle.actual_qty < 0
                THEN ABS(sle.actual_qty)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS issued_qty,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           CLOSING QTY
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS closing_qty,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           OPENING STOCK VALUE
           Value before From Date
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sle.posting_date < %(from_date)s
                THEN sle.stock_value_difference
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS opening_value,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           RECEIVED STOCK VALUE
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sle.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
                AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
                AND sle.stock_value_difference > 0
                THEN sle.stock_value_difference
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS received_value,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           ISSUED / CONSUMED VALUE
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sle.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
                AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
                AND sle.stock_value_difference < 0
                THEN ABS(sle.stock_value_difference)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS issued_value,


        /* -----------------------------------------
           CLOSING STOCK VALUE
           ----------------------------------------- */

        SUM(sle.stock_value_difference) AS closing_value


    FROM
        `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle


    INNER JOIN
        `tabItem` i
        ON i.name = sle.item_code


    WHERE

        sle.company = %(company)s

        AND sle.is_cancelled = 0

        AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s


        /* -----------------------------------------
           WAREHOUSE
           ----------------------------------------- */

        AND (
            %(warehouse)s IS NULL
            OR %(warehouse)s = ''
            OR sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s
        )


        /* -----------------------------------------
           ITEM
           ----------------------------------------- */

        AND (
            %(item_code)s IS NULL
            OR %(item_code)s = ''
            OR sle.item_code = %(item_code)s
        )


        /* -----------------------------------------
           ITEM GROUP
           ----------------------------------------- */

        AND (
            %(item_group)s IS NULL
            OR %(item_group)s = ''
            OR i.item_group = %(item_group)s
        )


    GROUP BY

        i.item_group,
        sle.item_code,
        i.item_name,
        i.stock_uom,
        sle.warehouse


    ORDER BY

        closing_value DESC
"""


query_filters = {
    "company": filters.get("company"),

    "from_date": filters.get("from_date"),

    "to_date": filters.get("to_date"),

    "warehouse": filters.get("warehouse"),

    "item_code": filters.get("item_code"),

    "item_group": filters.get("item_group")
}


data = frappe.db.sql(
    query,
    query_filters,
    as_dict=True
)


period_days = 1

if filters.get("from_date") and filters.get("to_date"):

    period_days = (
        frappe.utils.date_diff(
            filters.get("to_date"),
            filters.get("from_date")
        ) + 1
    )


for row in data:

    row["opening_qty"] = row.get("opening_qty") or 0

    row["received_qty"] = row.get("received_qty") or 0

    row["issued_qty"] = row.get("issued_qty") or 0

    row["closing_qty"] = row.get("closing_qty") or 0

    row["opening_value"] = row.get("opening_value") or 0

    row["received_value"] = row.get("received_value") or 0

    row["issued_value"] = row.get("issued_value") or 0

    row["closing_value"] = row.get("closing_value") or 0




    row["average_inventory_value"] = (
        row["opening_value"] +
        row["closing_value"]
    ) / 2




    row["turnover_ratio"] = 0

    if row["average_inventory_value"] > 0:

        row["turnover_ratio"] = (
            row["issued_value"] /
            row["average_inventory_value"]
        )


    # /* -----------------------------------------
    #   ANNUALIZED TURNOVER

    #   If the selected period is shorter than
    #   one year, annualize the ratio.
    #   ----------------------------------------- */

    annualized_turnover = 0

    if (
        row["average_inventory_value"] > 0
        and period_days > 0
    ):

        annualized_turnover = (
            row["issued_value"] /
            row["average_inventory_value"]
        ) * (
            365 /
            period_days
        )


    # /* -----------------------------------------
    #   TURNOVER DAYS

    #   Average Inventory /
    #   Daily Consumption
    #   ----------------------------------------- */

    row["turnover_days"] = None

    if (
        row["issued_value"] > 0
        and period_days > 0
    ):

        daily_consumption = (
            row["issued_value"] /
            period_days
        )

        if daily_consumption > 0:

            row["turnover_days"] = (
                row["average_inventory_value"] /
                daily_consumption
            )


    # /* -----------------------------------------
    #   TURNOVER STATUS
    #   ----------------------------------------- */

    high_turnover = (
        filters.get("high_turnover") or 6
    )

    normal_turnover = (
        filters.get("normal_turnover") or 3
    )

    low_turnover = (
        filters.get("low_turnover") or 1
    )


    if row["average_inventory_value"] <= 0:

        row["turnover_status"] = "No Inventory"


    elif row["issued_value"] <= 0:

        row["turnover_status"] = "No Movement"


    elif annualized_turnover >= high_turnover:

        row["turnover_status"] = "High Turnover"


    elif annualized_turnover >= normal_turnover:

        row["turnover_status"] = "Normal"


    elif annualized_turnover >= low_turnover:

        row["turnover_status"] = "Low Turnover"


    else:

        row["turnover_status"] = "Very Low"


data = columns, data
